methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched from each vendor's official pricing page using WebFetch. AWS S3 per-GB storage rates were confirmed directly from the AWS pricing CSV (pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/offers/v1.0/aws/AmazonS3/current/us-east-1/index.csv, effective 2026-06-01); egress rate corroborated via cloudzero.com/blog/cloud-storage-pricing. Cloudflare R2 rates from developers.cloudflare.com/r2/pricing. Backblaze B2 and DigitalOcean Spaces from their respective official pricing pages. Wasabi pricing from wasabi.com/pricing (note: price increases to $7.99/TB on 2026-07-01). Storj from storj.io/pricing (note: minimum monthly fee increases to $50 on 2026-07-01). Akamai Cloud (formerly Linode) from akamai.com/cloud/pricing. Vultr from vultr.com/products/object-storage. Google Cloud Storage page was too large to extract pricing numbers; GCS was excluded rather than guessing. All prices are US-region, pay-as-you-go unless noted. monthlyUsd is null for purely usage-metered services (no flat tier). billingModel=custom for usage-metered services. billingModel=flat for fixed monthly plans.

vendors.name: Amazon S3
vendors.provenance: Official AWS S3 pricing page (aws.amazon.com/s3/pricing) rendered JS-only tables not extractable; per-GB storage rates confirmed from AWS official pricing CSV at pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/offers/v1.0/aws/AmazonS3/current/us-east-1/index.csv (effective 2026-06-01). Egress rate corroborated via cloudzero.com/blog/cloud-storage-pricing. Request prices extracted from aws.amazon.com/s3/pricing page text.

plans.name: S3 Standard (pay-as-you-go)
plans.notes: Storage: $0.023/GB-month (first 50 TB/month), $0.022/GB-month (next 450 TB), $0.021/GB-month (over 500 TB). Data transfer out to internet: $0.09/GB (first 10 TB/month), $0.085/GB (next 40 TB), $0.07/GB (next 100 TB), $0.05/GB (over 150 TB). PUT/COPY/POST requests: $0.005 per 1,000. GET requests: $0.0004 per 1,000. First 100 GB egress/month free. No minimum fee.

plans.name: S3 Standard-IA (pay-as-you-go)
plans.notes: Storage: $0.0125/GB-month. Retrieval fee: $0.01/GB. PUT requests: $0.01 per 1,000. GET requests: $0.001 per 1,000. 30-day minimum storage duration; 128 KB minimum billable object size.

plans.name: S3 Glacier Deep Archive (pay-as-you-go)
plans.notes: Storage: $0.00099/GB-month. Retrieval: standard 12-hour restore, fee applies. 180-day minimum storage duration. Ideal for compliance/long-term archiving.

vendors.name: Cloudflare R2
vendors.provenance: Official Cloudflare R2 pricing page at developers.cloudflare.com/r2/pricing fetched directly. Free tier and paid tier rates confirmed.

plans.name: R2 Free Tier
plans.notes: Includes 10 GB-month storage, 1 million Class A operations/month, 10 million Class B operations/month. Zero egress fees always. Standard storage class only.

plans.name: R2 Standard (pay-as-you-go)
plans.notes: Storage: $0.015/GB-month. Class A operations (PUT, DELETE, etc.): $4.50 per million. Class B operations (GET, HEAD): $0.36 per million. Egress to internet: free always. Above the free tier allowances.

plans.name: R2 Infrequent Access (pay-as-you-go)
plans.notes: Storage: $0.01/GB-month. Class A operations: $9.00 per million. Class B operations: $0.90 per million. Data retrieval: $0.01/GB. Egress to internet: free. 30-day minimum storage duration.

vendors.name: Backblaze B2
vendors.provenance: Official Backblaze B2 pricing page at backblaze.com/cloud-storage/pricing fetched directly. Pay-as-you-go rates confirmed.

plans.name: B2 Cloud Storage (pay-as-you-go)
plans.notes: Storage: $0.00695/GB-month ($6.95/TB). First 10 GB storage always free. Egress: free up to 3x average monthly storage; $0.01/GB beyond that. Free egress via partner network (Cloudflare, Fastly, bunny.net). API calls (Class A, B, C): free. Class D transactions: $0.004 per 10,000 calls (first 2,500/day free). US West region.

plans.name: B2 Reserve
plans.notes: Annual commitment pricing. Example: $19,500/year for 250TB ($78/TB/year or $6.50/TB/month). Contact sales for custom quotes. Includes B2 Overdrive (unlimited egress) and premium support.

vendors.name: Wasabi
vendors.provenance: Official Wasabi pricing page at wasabi.com/pricing fetched directly. Current pay-as-you-go rate and upcoming price change on 2026-07-01 confirmed. Reserved capacity pricing tiers require custom quote (sales contact).

plans.name: Wasabi Hot Cloud Storage (pay-as-you-go)
plans.notes: Storage: $0.00699/GB-month ($6.99/TB) as of June 2026. Price increases to $0.00799/GB-month ($7.99/TB) effective 2026-07-01. No egress fees. No API request fees. No minimum storage requirement. Basic support included. Free trial available (duration/limits not published).

plans.name: Wasabi Reserved Capacity Storage
plans.notes: Annual/multi-year commitment pricing for large volumes (25TB, 100TB, 250TB, 500TB, 1PB, 1.5PB, 5PB, 10PB units). Exact rates require contact with sales. Includes premium support and discounts off pay-as-you-go rate. 1-, 3-, or 5-year terms available.

vendors.name: DigitalOcean Spaces
vendors.provenance: Official DigitalOcean Spaces pricing fetched from docs.digitalocean.com/products/spaces/details/pricing. All base plan, overage, CDN, and transfer details confirmed directly.

plans.name: Spaces Subscription
plans.notes: Includes 250 GiB storage and 1,024 GiB outbound data transfer per month. CDN included at no additional cost. Overage: $0.02/GiB additional storage; $0.01/GiB additional outbound transfer. S3-compatible API.

vendors.name: Storj
vendors.provenance: Official Storj pricing page at storj.io/pricing fetched directly. Standard and Advanced plan rates, free trial, and minimum monthly fee changes confirmed.

plans.name: Storj Free Trial
plans.notes: 25 GB storage for 30 days. No credit card required. Includes 2 Object Mount licenses. After trial, account converts to paid Standard plan.

plans.name: Storj Standard
plans.notes: Storage: $7/TB-month ($0.007/GB-month). Egress/download: $7/TB ($0.007/GB). No segment fees. 50 KB minimum object size. 30-day minimum retention (early deletion fees apply). Minimum monthly fee of $50 effective 2026-07-01 (STORJ token payers exempt). Distributed globally across tens of thousands of nodes.

plans.name: Storj Advanced
plans.notes: Storage: $10/TB-month ($0.01/GB-month) for Object Mount license. Egress: $7/TB ($0.007/GB). Data stored in US SOC2 Type 2 compliant data centers. Includes 2 Object Mount licenses. Same $50/month minimum applies from 2026-07-01.

vendors.name: Akamai Cloud Object Storage
vendors.provenance: Official Akamai Cloud pricing page at akamai.com/cloud/pricing fetched directly (linode.com/pricing redirects there). Storage, egress, and minimum fee confirmed.

plans.name: Akamai Object Storage (pay-as-you-go)
plans.notes: Storage: $0.02/GB-month. Outbound transfer: $0.005/GB (first 1 TB/month free). No API request fees mentioned. $5 minimum monthly fee for accounts storing less than 250 GB. Pricing may vary by region. S3-compatible API.

vendors.name: Vultr Object Storage
vendors.provenance: Official Vultr Object Storage product page at vultr.com/products/object-storage fetched directly. All five storage tiers confirmed with monthly rates, included capacity, and overage pricing.

plans.name: Vultr Archival Object Storage
plans.notes: Includes 1 TB storage + 1 TB bandwidth/month. $6/TB additional storage. $10/TB additional transfer beyond included. No API request fees. Built for long-term, infrequently accessed data.

plans.name: Vultr Standard Object Storage
plans.notes: Includes 1 TB storage + 1 TB bandwidth/month. $18/TB additional storage. $10/TB additional transfer beyond included. No API request fees. Suited for low-cost general data storage.

plans.name: Vultr Premium Object Storage
plans.notes: Includes 1 TB storage + 1 TB bandwidth/month. $36/TB additional storage. $10/TB additional transfer beyond included. Suited for application data with wide range of use cases.

plans.name: Vultr Performance Object Storage
plans.notes: Includes 1 TB storage + 1 TB bandwidth/month. $50/TB additional storage. $10/TB additional transfer beyond included. Ideal for workloads requiring higher performance than typical internet-based storage.

plans.name: Vultr Accelerated Object Storage
plans.notes: Includes 1 TB storage + 1 TB bandwidth/month. $100/TB additional storage. $10/TB additional transfer beyond included. Designed for most demanding use cases requiring rapid, low-latency storage.
